name: Anika Sharma
title: My baby's favourite first food
review: I started giving my daughter the Sprouted Channa & Dalia at 6 months and she took to it immediately. The texture is perfectly smooth — no lumps, no fuss. As a first-time mum I was anxious about solids, but Mamma Mills made the whole weaning journey so much calmer. I love that the ingredients are clean and sprouted, which I know improves digestibility. She finishes every bowl and looks for more. We're now on our fifth order.

name: Rhea Kapoor
title: Finally a baby food I trust
review: I've tried so many baby food brands and most are either too processed or too bland for my son to enjoy. Mamma Mills is different — the sprouted grains make it naturally easier to digest and the taste is mild and wholesome. My son is 9 months old and has been on this for three months now. No reactions, no bloating, just a happy well-fed baby. The packaging is clean and informative too. I recommend this to every mum in my mommy group.

name: Meera Pillai
title: Wholesome, simple, and honest
review: Ordered the Sprouted Channa & Dalia and the Ragi Idli Mix together. Both arrived well-packaged and the quality is genuinely impressive. The Channa & Dalia cooks into a lovely soft porridge in under two minutes — perfect for busy mornings. My 8-month-old has been having it daily for six weeks with no issues at all. My only feedback is that I wish the pack size was larger. The product itself is excellent and I will keep buying.

name: Divya Nair
title: Exactly what I was looking for
review: I wanted baby food with no additives, no preservatives, and no hidden sugar — Mamma Mills delivers on all three. The sprouting process is what sold me; it reduces phytic acid and makes the nutrients more bioavailable for little ones. My pediatrician approved of the ingredient list without any hesitation. My daughter has been thriving on this since 6 months. This is the kind of product you trust and keep reordering.

name: Sanya Khanna
title: Ready in two minutes, loved every time
review: No complicated preparation, no long cook times — just add water, stir, and done. The Sprouted Channa & Dalia comes out smooth and creamy every time. My 7-month-old opens his mouth the second he sees the bowl coming. Delivery was fast and the packaging kept everything fresh. One of the best baby food purchases I've made and I've tried at least six other brands before this.

name: Ishita Roy
title: Best baby food brand I've found
review: Everything from Mamma Mills just works. Clean ingredients, great texture, and my baby actually enjoys it.

name: Tanvi Mehta
title: Gentle on tiny tummies
review: Been giving this since 6 months. Zero digestive issues, great appetite. Exactly what a new mum needs.

name: Preethi Subramanian
title: Pediatrician approved
review: Our doctor looked at the ingredient list and said it was one of the cleanest baby foods she had seen. That settled it for us.

name: Zara Qureshi
title: Fourth order and counting
review: Started with one pack to try. My baby loved it so much I immediately ordered four more. Mamma Mills has a loyal customer in me.

name: Nidhi Gupta
title: No additives, no worries
review: Quality is consistent across every order. Knowing exactly what goes into my baby's food gives me real peace of mind.

name: Aarohi Jain
title: Cooks in two minutes
review: Perfect for rushed mornings. Smooth, nutritious, and my baby finishes every bite.

name: Kritika Bose
title: Dairy-free and delicious
review: My baby has a milk sensitivity so finding a clean dairy-free option was a relief. She loves this.

name: Puja Ahluwalia
title: Great weaning food
review: Made the transition to solids so easy. Smooth texture, mild taste — my baby took to it from day one.

name: Supriya Datta
title: Mamma Mills gets it right
review: Simple, clean, sprouted. Exactly what baby food should be.

name: Falak Mirza
title: Baby's daily staple
review: 10 months old and we have this every single morning. That says everything.
